title: Treasury Analyst
description: WHO WE ARE Trustly is leading the human centric payments revolution. Whether it's for shopping, paying subscriptions, funding trading accounts, booking airfare, playing online games and much more, we're all about a better way to pay. Desirable: ACT, ACCA, CIMA or ACA, or part qualified; Experience with an ERP, a TMS and multi bank platforms; Interest in automation or AI tools for treasury work. You will own the COGS profit and loss line (bank fees and hosting costs) and the unit economics across the cost base, partnering closely with Banking, Infrastructure and Engineering to control and improve margins. title: Senior FP&A Analyst
description: <h3>United Kingdom (Remote)</h3> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>About Us</strong></h3> <p>Reachdesk is the first truly end-to-end global gifting and swag platform, helping B2B companies create meaningful connections with prospects, customers, and employees: while driving measurable ROI.</p> <p>We believe gifting is more than just a transaction: it’s about building genuine human connections that fuel business growth. Whether you’re engaging prospects, celebrating customers, or recognizing employees, our platform makes it easy to deliver personalized gifts, branded swag, and unforgettable event & brand experiences at scale through automated sourcing, storage, and global delivery.</p> <p>Trusted by many of the most recognized names in technology and SaaS, Reachdesk integrates effortlessly with your marketing, sales, and HRIS tech stack and is powered by a world-class team with hubs in New York, London, and Lisbon.</p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>We're looking for an exceptional Senior Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) Analyst to help us understand performance, plan for the future, and make better business decisions. Reporting to our CFO, you'll own core planning and forecasting, turn data into clear insights and recommendations, and work directly with leaders and teams across the business to improve decisions and execution.</p> <p>Our business model uniquely combines SaaS and prepaid customer wallets with a global gift marketplace, branded merchandise, and international fulfilment. That creates complex planning and analysis across recurring and transactional revenue, margins, cash and wallet dynamics, and multiple entities and currencies.</p> <p>Your impact will extend well beyond building models and reporting numbers. You'll bring ideas and perspective, challenge assumptions, solve problems, and help turn analysis into action. You'll be equally adept at getting into the details and stepping back to understand what the numbers mean for the business.</p> <p>You'll work across NetSuite, Salesforce, DealHub, and our reporting tools, with a strong focus on automation and AI, helping build an FP&A function that is insightful, efficient, and closely connected to the business.</p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Build and maintain the consolidated operating model and rolling P&L and cash forecasts across entities and revenue streams, including customer wallet balances.</li> <li>Own the annual budget and quarterly forecasting process, with clear analysis of performance, variances, risks, and opportunities.</li> <li>Work directly with leaders and budget holders across the business to understand performance, challenge assumptions, solve problems, and drive work through completion.</li> <li>Prepare monthly management reporting and board and investor materials, turning financial and operational data into clear insights and recommendations.</li> <li>Analyse unit economics and margin by revenue stream to support pricing, deal, investment, and other commercial decisions.</li> <li>Define and maintain consistent definitions for key business metrics, including ARR, retention, and margin by revenue stream, ensuring they reconcile to reported financials each month.</li> <li>Calculate sales commissions and support the design and review of commission plans.</li> <li>Provide transaction analysis to support tax decisions, including VAT registrations and disclosures, and US sales tax thresholds.</li> <li>Maintain accurate dashboards and self-service performance reporting for budget holders and leadership, partnering with our business systems team on data and integrations.</li> <li>Improve and automate forecasting, reporting, and variance analysis, using AI and other tools to increase the speed and quality of our work.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3><strong>About You</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Typically 2–5 years of relevant experience with increasing responsibility in FP&A, corporate finance, audit, transaction services, or another highly analytical finance role.</li> <li>Excellent financial modelling skills, including driver-based forecasting and experience building or working with integrated financial models.</li> <li>Strong business judgement and curiosity, with the ability to move from analysis to clear implications, recommendations, and action.</li> <li>Proven ability to take ownership, work effectively across teams, build credibility with non-finance colleagues, and drive work through completion.</li> <li>Strong accounting foundation and the ability to connect operational metrics, forecasts, and financial results back to the general ledger.</li> <li>Skilled at working with data across multiple systems; ERP and CRM experience is valuable, with NetSuite and Salesforce preferred.</li> <li>Demonstrated fluency with AI and automation tools, with a track record of applying them to improve the speed and quality of Finance work.</li> <li>Clear, concise communicator who can explain complex analysis to non-finance audiences and produce high-quality materials for senior leaders and the board.</li> <li>Proactive, highly organised, and effective in a fast-moving international business where priorities can evolve quickly.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience with SaaS metrics such as ARR, retention, and cohort analysis.</li> <li>Experience with marketplace, physical goods, prepaid, or payments business models.</li> <li>Experience with multi-entity or multi-currency planning across the UK, US, or Europe.</li> <li>Experience with SQL, Power BI, Looker, or similar data and reporting tools.</li> <li>Exposure to sales commissions, indirect tax, or other transaction-level financial analysis.</li> <li>Part-qualified or fully qualified ACA, ACCA, CIMA, or equivalent professional accounting qualification is a plus.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3><strong>The Benefits</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Competitive salary with generous stock options</li> <li>Pension with employer contributions (NEST)</li> <li>Affordable Private Medical Insurance, including mental health support and fast access to care</li> <li>Flexible PTO that increases the longer you’re with us, plus extra flexibility for life’s unexpected moments</li> <li>A genuinely collaborative culture with innovative, fun, and ambitious people</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>Reachdesk believes that a diverse team helps us achieve our mission faster, and so we welcome applicants from all backgrounds. </p> <p> </p> <p><em>Privacy Policy: We process personal information submitted as part of your application in accordance with the Reachdesk Candidate Privacy Notice. Please review Reachdesk’s Privacy Policy here:</em></p> <p><a href="http://www.reachdesk.com/candidate-privacy-policy"><em>www.reachdesk.com/candidate-privacy-policy</em></a><em> </em></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>3834 - Associate Director, Social, UK</strong></p> <p>Role Summary and Impact</p> <p>The <strong>Associate Director, Social</strong> is a senior leader responsible for the strategic oversight, operational excellence, and overall success of a large group within the campaign delivery function. This role leads a team of Senior Campaign Managers, Campaign Managers, and Executives, setting the standard for executional quality, profitability, and innovation. The Campaign Director is accountable for ensuring their entire group's campaign portfolio is delivered to the highest standard, driving client satisfaction and retention through flawless execution and strategic leadership.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>Departmental Leadership & Operational Excellence</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead, mentor, and develop a "group" within the campaign team, including Senior Campaign Managers, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.</li> <li>Take ultimate responsibility for the successful delivery of all campaigns within your group, having visibility over progress without being involved in the day-to-day running.</li> <li>Organise and delegate work effectively within your group, ensuring efficient campaign execution and accurate workload monitoring.</li> <li>Champion and enforce all Goat standards and processes, ensuring your team operates with efficiency and accuracy, and that target margins are consistently met.</li> <li>Consistently develop and implement new processes to improve campaign performance and team efficiencies.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Strategic & Commercial Oversight</strong></p> <ul> <li>Take responsibility for client retention and growth within your group, proactively looking for optimisations and opportunities for the account team to upsell.</li> <li>Act as the senior sign-off for deliverables (up to £500k) and complex influencer contracts (above £20,000) within your group, ensuring they are commercially sound and strategically aligned.</li> <li>Think about all campaigns from a business perspective, with revenue and profitability always in mind.</li> <li>Provide senior executional leadership in high-value proposals and pitches, confidently presenting campaign processes and demonstrating expert knowledge of a client's objectives.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Team Management & Development</strong></p> <ul> <li>Successfully manage the performance and career progression of your direct reports and wider group, tracking individual progress and providing solutions for underperformance.</li> <li>Identify and nurture future leaders within your group, highlighting successes and promoting a positive team morale.</li> <li>Ensure all members of your team have measurable, challenging, and achievable targets.</li> <li>Lead training initiatives, spotting knowledge gaps and working with other Directors to ensure a consistent and engaging training programme for the global campaign team.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Quality Assurance & Senior Escalation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as the senior point of escalation for all major executional challenges, able to jump into any campaign to troubleshoot problems and provide solutions.</li> <li>Be responsible for troubleshooting any major content quality issues before they are escalated to a Senior Director.</li> <li>Act as the final sign-off on Post-Campaign Analyses (PCAs) for key clients, ensuring they are insightful, accurate, and tailored to the client's priorities.</li> <li>Ensure your team is consistently using all internal platforms (e.g., CreatorIQ) correctly and to their full potential.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Performance Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>The successful, profitable, and high-quality delivery of the entire campaign portfolio within your group.</li> <li>A demonstrable contribution to key client retention and growth through proactive strategic optimisations.</li> <li>The successful leadership, development, and high morale of your campaign group.</li> <li>The successful implementation of new processes that drive efficiency and performance.</li> <li>Positive feedback from senior internal and external stakeholders on the leadership and operational excellence of your group.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none">Life at WPP Media & Benefits</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">Championing Growth and Development</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">We</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">Create an Open environment</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</span><span data-contrast="none"> Please note that while our philosophy is the same title: Partner Success Manager, EMEA
description: Ironclad is the leading AI contracting platform that transforms agreements into assets. Contracts move faster, insights surface instantly, and agents push work forward, all with you in control. Whether you’re buying or selling, Ironclad unifies the entire process on one intelligent platform, providing leaders with the visibility they need to stay one step ahead. That’s why the world’s most transformative organizations, from Rivian to the World Health Organization and the Associated Press, trust Ironclad to accelerate their business. We’re consistently recognized as a leader in the industry: a Leader in the Forrester Wave and Gartner Magic Quadrant for Contract Lifecycle Management, a Fortune Great Place to Work, and one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Workplaces. Ironclad has also been named to Forbes’ AI 50 and Business Insider’s list of Companies to Bet Your Career On. We’re backed by leading investors including Accel, Y Combinator, Sequoia, BOND, and Franklin Templeton. For more information, visit www.ironcladapp.com or follow us on LinkedIn. This is a hybrid role. Office attendance is expected two days per week on Tuesdays and Thursdays in London. There may be additional in-office days for team or company events. Ironclad is scaling rapidly across EMEA through a partner-first go-to-market model. We’re looking for an entrepreneurial, proactive EMEA Partner Success Manager to shape and operationalise our Global Partner Services programs—building effective partner engagement, enablement, readiness, and collaboration across the region. As part of Customer Value, you’ll support partner services across the customer lifecycle, from pre-sales alignment and delivery readiness through co-delivery and post-live adoption. Working with major systems integrators and consulting firms, you’ll help evolve a value-focused model that starts earlier in the customer journey and extends beyond implementation to improve conversion, accelerate time to value, increase platform usage, and strengthen long-term customer outcomes. You’ll bring a strong operator’s mindset: turning ambiguity into clear, repeatable ways of working across Sales, Alliances, Technical Services, Customer Success, and external partners. You’ll use data to improve program performance and, based in London, spend regular time in the office and face-to-face with partners to build relationships and help them succeed. What you'll do: Own relationships with strategic partners’ practice and delivery leaders, aligning on priorities, readiness, quality expectations, capacity, and growth opportunities. Partner with Sales, Alliances, and Customer Value to match qualified opportunities with the right partner, co-delivery model, and implementation approach based on customer needs, deal context, partner readiness, and expectations. Operationalise partner engagement across the customer lifecycle—from discovery and scoping through readiness planning, delivery transition, and post-live support—clarifying roles and setting engagements up for execution and adoption. Evolve partner programs with Partner Alliances, Enablement, and Customer Value leadership, including co-delivery and subcontracting frameworks, onboarding, certification, methodology alignment, delivery quality, and ongoing enablement. Assess partner capacity, coverage, skills, and readiness against business demand and EMEA growth priorities; coordinate capacity planning across strategic and subcontracting relationships to improve predictability. Build targeted partner enablement plans across product knowledge, implementation, integrations, value selling, customer change management, AI use cases, and emerging AI consumption models; help partners adapt capabilities and commercial/delivery approaches as opportunities evolve. Work with EA and partner teams to understand partner ISV offerings, technology ecosystems, integrations, and customer architecture requirements, and connect differentiated capabilities to customer opportunities. Help partner-led engagements establish a path to customer enablement, adoption, value realisation, and sustained platform usage after go-live; reinforce accountability for agreed post-live milestones. Identify patterns in partner-led work that affect conversion, delivery quality, time to value, adoption health, renewal readiness, and expansion potential; translate findings into practical program improvements. Establish an EMEA partner operating rhythm (in partnership with EMEA Partner Alliances) —including business reviews, readiness and capacity assessments, enablement planning, and escalation management—and keep partners current on regional priorities, market dynamics, customer needs, and product and go-to-market changes. Maintain operational hygiene and data integrity for partner-led projects and programs across internal systems, reporting, and workflows; translate feedback from European partners and customers into actionable recommendations for Ironclad teams. What success looks like: A scalable EMEA partner-first operating model and a clear, consistent operating rhythm. Better alignment between partner strategy and qualified deal motions, with greater confidence in partner fit, readiness, and implementation approach before kickoff. More predictable partner capacity and targeted capability plans, with priority enablement gaps owned and closed. Consistent, high-quality partner-led and co-delivered services, with clear roles across EA, Sales, Alliances, Services, Customer Value, and partners. Partners equipped to respond to EMEA priorities and AI-led opportunities; partner ISV and integration capabilities connected to relevant customer needs. Improved customer time to value, adoption, sustained usage, and expansion outcomes, with a positive contribution to adoption health, GRR, and NDR-oriented outcomes. What we're looking for: 5+ years of experience in Professional Services, Partner Operations, Customer Success, Implementation, or a related role at a SaaS company and/or consulting or systems integration firm. 2+ years of experience working with implementation partners, subcontractors, or partner delivery teams in a services environment. Experience supporting complex pre-sales, scoping, or solution-alignment motions with Sales, Services, and/or Alliances teams; implementation, managed, partner services, or GSI experience is highly relevant. Strong program management skills and a track record of building or improving cross-functional processes spanning internal teams and external partners. Ability to bring structure to ambiguity and execute repeatable operating models in a fast-changing environment. Strong relationship-building, influencing, and communication skills, including the ability to work with senior stakeholders across functions and geographies and turn complex considerations into clear recommendations. title: Business Recruiter
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London | 💰£58,400 - £79,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>  ✨</p> <p><strong>Our Business Hiring team⭐</strong></p> <p>We’re a small but mighty team, working on all the roles that are <strong><em>not</em></strong> Tech (Engineering, Product, Data or Design) and <strong><em>not</em></strong> in the world of Customer Service. In other companies, this is sometimes known as Corporate Functions. We touch on a huge variety of roles and so we talk to lots of different types of people every day. We're looking for support to boost our hiring efforts as the business scales.</p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by…</strong></p> <p><em>You’ll work with Hiring Managers to structure and run great hiring processes.</em></p> <ul> <li>Our hiring managers are often busy team leads and executives. They’ll need your help to identify what skills they’re looking for and how best to assess these. You’ll be confident challenging their thinking and asking the right questions to figure this out. You’ll own everything about the hiring process from beginning to end, and be skilled at convincing candidates to join us.</li> </ul> <p><em>You’ll care deeply about diversity and inclusiveness, and giving candidates an amazing experience</em></p> <ul> <li>We want to go the extra mile to make sure that every applicant to every job feels valued, respected and never wavers in their support for Monzo, whatever the outcome of their application. You’ll know where to find the right candidates from a range of backgrounds and have ideas about how to make sure they feel welcome at Monzo. And once we’ve decided we want to hire someone, you’ll move mountains in the background to make it an effortless, pleasant process, and keep that excitement burning.</li> </ul> <p><em>You’ll love sourcing and be great at spotting great talent in CVs</em></p> <ul> <li>You’ll be great at sourcing passive candidates yourself, and thinking about how to get the best people interested in Monzo. You’ll be comfortable managing large volumes of applications and picking out those that best fit our requirements.</li> </ul> <p><em>You’ll be passionate about making processes work better.</em></p> <ul> <li>We constantly refine our hiring processes to make them simpler and more effective. You’ll use data to work out what’s going well and where things could be better, and share your findings with other members of the hiring team so we can all improve.</li> </ul> <p><em>You might already have a specialist area but you’ll be comfortable working on any role</em></p> <ul> <li>We don’t mind if you’re a generalist recruiter, or if you already have a specialism, as long as you’re initially happy getting stuck into hiring any role that needs you. You’ll work closely with other members of the hiring team to solve company-wide hiring problems, share what you already know and learn from their experiences. As the team builds out, you’ll be able to continue specialising as an individual contributor, or explore development into management or leadership.</li> </ul> <p><em>You’ll be data-driven and comfortable running your own reports</em></p> <ul> <li>You’ll be comfortable using data to support your suggestions and observations within a hiring process.You’ll actively bring useful insights to your hiring managers to help them make informed decisions on process improvements and candidates.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You’ve got experience recruiting multiple roles, possibly in a range of disciplines</li> <li>You care deeply about inclusiveness and diversity</li> <li>You love sourcing and pride yourself on your resourcefulness</li> <li>You’re empathetic, adaptable and respectful of candidates’ needs and priorities</li> <li>You can adapt your approach to work with a range of stakeholders with different needs</li> <li>You can tell whether somebody has the skills we’re looking for, without relying on previous job titles or qualifications</li> </ul> <p>It would be great if:</p> <ul> <li>You've got experience recruiting in-house at a startup or scale-up</li> <li>You've worked directly with executives</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £58,400 - £79,000 salary range ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>A recruiter call with the Hiring Manager</li> <li>A loop interview with members of the hiring team and a key stakeholder</li> <li>Final feedback and reverse interview</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>#LI-DH1 </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: New Business Director [Global]
description: About WPP Production We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world. About WPP WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com . A Hybrid working model We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. What does the New Business Director (Global) do a WPP Production? The role The New Business Director plays a pivotal role in shaping and driving growth for WPP Production, defining how we win high-value, complex opportunities and shaping the strategic direction of our growth function. This is a highly strategic role, responsible for designing integrated solutions, evolving go-to-market propositions and building a repeatable growth engine that enables the business to win consistently across markets and opportunity types. You will lead the strategic direction and narrative for priority opportunities — ensuring that every response is clearly positioned, commercially compelling and aligned to client needs. You will be accountable for the quality and consistency of our narrative and strategic output across all pitches, setting the standard for how we articulate our value. Working closely with senior stakeholders across WPP Production and the wider WPP network, you will play a key role in driving integration across Media, Creative and Production, shaping how we bring together capabilities to deliver differentiated client solutions. Beyond individual opportunities, you will take a broader view of growth — defining where we should focus, how we prioritise opportunities, and how we scale success globally. This includes evolving our approach to pitches, refining commercial models and embedding best practice ways of working across the team. This is a high-impact role with visibility across the business, suited to someone who thrives in complexity, operates with a high level of autonomy, and is motivated by driving measurable growth and business impact at scale. Key areas of responsibility Define and lead the strategic direction for priority, high-value opportunities, ensuring a clear and differentiated approach to winning Accountable for the narrative quality and strategic standard across all pitches, setting the benchmark for how we articulate our value Design end-to-end client solutions and commercial models, including operating models, pricing approach and value proposition Lead the development of go-to-market propositions, continuously evolving how WPP Production positions itself in market Work with the Global Chief Growth Officer to define and drive the global growth strategy for WPP Production, identifying priority markets, opportunity types and areas of focus Define and influence where we focus our growth efforts, ensuring time and resource are prioritised on the highest value opportunities Analyse pipeline, performance and market trends to identify where growth is coming from — and where it should come from next Partner with senior leadership to shape growth priorities, targets and investment decisions Drive improved conversion, efficiency and revenue impact across the new business pipeline through stronger strategic positioning and approach Build and scale a repeatable growth engine, embedding frameworks, playbooks, tools and best practice that enable teams globally to win consistently without central dependency Act as a "pitch doctor", stepping into critical opportunities to strengthen narrative, structure and overall response quality Present and represent WPP Production in senior client meetings & pitch meetings Drive cross-WPP integration, ensuring seamless collaboration across Media, Creative and Production Identify and embed new ways of working, improving how we approach, structure and deliver pitches Lead on innovation in growth, including exploring the use of AI and new technologies to enhance team capability and efficiency Build and maintain strong relationships with senior stakeholders across WPP and key client organisations Develop and scale team capability, through coaching, mentoring and training What good looks like (key requirements) Significant experience (typically 10+ years) in new business, growth or strategy roles within a creative, production or agency environment Exceptional strategic thinking, with a proven ability to define how complex opportunities are approached and won Outstanding writing and storytelling ability, with experience leading narrative development for high-value, multi-disciplinary pitches Strong commercial acumen, with experience designing and influencing commercial models, pricing strategies and value propositions Proven experience leading large, complex and high-value pitch processes, often involving multiple stakeholders and disciplines Confident and credible communicator, with experience presenting to senior clients and influencing at leadership level Comfortable operating at pace and under pressure, managing multiple high-stakes In this role, you’ll get to: Lead, develop, and strengthen a high-performing team of Enterprise Account Executives, creating clear expectations, strong coaching practices, and a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. Build and execute an EMEA enterprise sales strategy focused on net-new customer acquisition, and growth within existing enterprise accounts. Develop a strong, sustainable pipeline and maintain forecasting discipline that improves accuracy, visibility, and predictability across the region. Accelerate enterprise revenue growth by leading complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and helping the team effectively engage C-suite executives and senior decision-makers. Own regional sales performance against quarterly and annual revenue objectives, leveraging qualitative and quantitative data to identify opportunities, risks, and actions necessary to drive results and compress deal cycles. Build and maintain strategic relationships with enterprise customers and prospects, serving as a senior commercial partner and trusted advisor throughout the full customer lifecycle. Partner closely with Marketing, Customer Success, Product, and other cross-functional teams to align go-to-market priorities, support customer growth, and strengthen CreatorIQ’s position in the market. Identify opportunities to expand CreatorIQ’s presence across priority EU markets while staying close to industry trends, competitive dynamics, and evolving customer needs. Uplevel the Enterprise Sales organization by improving sales practices, talent development, operating discipline, and the systems and processes needed to support sustainable growth. Who you are and what you’ll need for this position: 5+ years of sales leadership experience, with a focus on enterprise sales in a SaaS environment. Proven success leading and developing enterprise sales teams and delivering sustained revenue growth. Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles and selling to large organizations. Strong executive presence and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage and influence C-suite executives and senior decision-makers. A strategic and commercially focused approach, with the ability to translate company growth priorities into clear regional sales plans and execution. A data-driven approach to pipeline management, forecasting, performance measurement, and sales decision-making. Strong proficiency with sales tools and CRM systems, including Salesforce, and a deep understanding of pipeline management and reporting. Sponsors and prioritizes responsible AI adoption, secures needed support and resources, and ensures AI initiatives deliver business value while following governance standards. Ability and willingness to travel approximately 40% of the time across EMEA. Experience in marketing technology and/or the creator or influencer marketing industry, and additional European language capabilities such as French or Spanish, are a plus. Excited about this opportunity? Passionate about what we do at CreatorIQ? Please apply! CreatorIQ is a place where everyone can grow. What you will get from us: People: work with talented, collaborative, and friendly people who love what they do. Guidance: utilize our learning platform to fully get the training and tools you’ll need to become successful here from your first day with us. Work/life harmony: 25 days vacation, floating and set holidays, wellness allowance, and paid parental leave. Stock options as part of our equity-sharing program. Healthcare coverage, encompassing mental health, physical therapies, dental, vision, cancer coverage, and more. Comprehensive perks program providing stipends for wellness, cell phone and internet, home office setup, mental wellness, professional development, plus occasional company-funded meal opportunities throughout the year. Who we are: CreatorIQ is the operating system for creator-led growth, helping global brands and agencies transform creator marketing into an intelligence-driven growth engine. CreatorIQ is a global company headquartered in Los Angeles with offices in Austin, New York, San Francisco, London, Manila, and Warsaw. title: Enterprise Account Executive (UK)
description: About the Company Why We Built Lyric: Supply chains are more critical and complex than ever. Every day, large enterprises navigate trillions of possible decisions that could impact the bottom line. Powerful algorithms and AI can address these problems, yet most organizations struggle to leverage supply chain AI at scale. The current SCM technologies are either rigid, limited-scope point solutions or custom solutions built in-house, which demand immense expertise and investment. That is…until now. Enter Lyric : Lyric is an enterprise AI platform built specifically for supply chains, offering the best of both worlds: Out-of-the-box AI solutions for optimizing networks, allocating inventory, scheduling routes, planning fulfillment capacity, promising orders, propagating demand, building predictions, analyzing scenarios, and more, plus A platform-first approach that empowers both business and technical users with end-to-end product composability, leveraging no-code tools, their own code, or even forking our code to build and refine supply chain decision intelligence With Lyric, enterprises no longer have to choose between flexibility and speed, they get both. The Mission: We’re building a new era in supply chain with the team best equipped to lead it. With over 20 years at the intersection of supply chain and algorithms, we developed a deep conviction that global supply chains needed something like Lyric. Since our inception in December 2021, that conviction has been validated time and time again. Today, a growing number of Fortune 500 companies, including Smurfit WestRock, Estée Lauder, Coca-Cola, and more, are innovating on their own terms with Lyric. We can’t wait to see what our customers, both current and future, are empowered to build with us next. Come build with us! About the Role We’re looking for an experienced Account Executive to join our growing enterprise sales team. You will own the entire deal cycle, generating pipeline, closing target customers, and expanding relationships over time. You’re the right fit for this role if you are excited by joining an early-stage team and building in an autonomous and highly creative environment. What You’ll Do Own our land and expand deal cycle from initial conversation to close with critical stakeholders in enterprise companies Contribute to the development of the Lyric Land and Expand sales playbook and execution strategy, including the implementation of an effective sales methodology Plan and provide regular forecasting across your book of business Join Lyric’s best in class GTM team, consisting of highly experienced, top-performers evangelizing the market on the premier SCM AI platform Provide input to the direction of sales strategy, enablement, and operations tools and workflows (CRM, forecasting, lead gen tools, pipeline management, outreach automation) About You 5-6+ years of complex enterprise sales experience. This experience can come in two different forms, both equally weighted in importance Experience closing enterprise platform, AI, and/or Data & Analytics software deals Experience closing enterprise supply chain, AI, and/or Data & Analytics services deals Demonstrated ability to deliver and drive logo acquisition deals in a fast paced and early stage environment Demonstrated ability to prospect to and engage with customers to understand their supply chain and operational challenges, and translate those challenges to business impacts Demonstrated comfort with Supply Chain or Operations Research terminology and mid-level to executive personas We’re Also Looking For Proven track record of overachievement in previous revenue-generating roles, driving 6- and 7-figure multi-year enterprise deals to close Experience selling and negotiating enterprise contracts to C- level, senior technical, and/or business stakeholders Self-starter with infectious enthusiasm, an out-of-the-box thinker who sees opportunities and solutions, not roadblocks Even if you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications, we recommend applying to the role! Location: Remote - UK. Some travel required. Compensation: We provide a competitive mix of salary, commissions, local benefits, and equity, designed to reward both your impact and growth. title: Partnerships Manager
description: About CuspAI CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering. We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock. We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters. We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us. Due to ongoing growth and demand, we’re looking for a Partnerships Manager to build relationships and lead materials design engagements with potential partners in Europe. Early stage, big market. Materials are a trillion-dollar problem, and most R&D organizations are only starting to use AI. You shape it from day one. You'll help decide who we work with, how we go to market and which partnerships make it grow. What You Will Do Build the pipeline Identify and reach R&D, materials and chemicals teams at US industrial companies that can benefit from direct access to our AI and data. Own your pipeline end to end, from the first conversation to a signed agreement. Use your network and market knowledge to open doors in key innovation hubs such as the Bay Area, Boston, Texas and the Research Triangle. Close and grow partnerships Understand each team's materials challenges and turn them into clear, compelling proposals together with our scientists and Technical Program Managers. Negotiate commercial terms and bring agreements to signature. Turn first engagements into lasting relationships, and spot where a partner can do more with us. Shape how we go to market Help decide which customer types and sectors to focus on first, based on what converts fastest. Bring what you hear in the market back to our product, research and leadership teams. Help build the processes, materials and playbook that the wider team will use as we grow. Represent CuspAI at industry events and conferences. What We're Looking For Someone who has sold to or partnered with R&D, chemicals or materials organizations, and who enjoys building something new more than running a process that already works. 8+ years in partnerships, business development or sales roles selling to industrial R&D, materials, chemicals or semiconductor organizations. Experience bringing digital R&D tools to scientific teams, for example materials informatics, lab data platforms (ELN, LIMS) or simulation software. A track record of sourcing and closing B2B deals with multiple stakeholders and long sales cycles. A network among R&D and business leaders at US industrial companies. The ability to explain AI and computational concepts clearly to scientists and business leaders alike. Comfort with ambiguity, and the drive to build structure from scratch in a fast-growing startup. Willingness to travel regularly within the US and to Europe. Bonus Points (But Not Critical) An advanced degree in chemistry, materials science, physics, chemical engineering or a related field. Experience at a company working in materials informatics, scientific software or AI for R&D. Experience building a market or commercial function from the ground up. Location This role is based in the UK ideally London or Cambridge or Berlin oder Amsterdam, ideally near a major materials, chemicals or semiconductor hub. Expect regular travel to customer sites and to our offices in the UK and Europe (30 - 40 %) What We Offer A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. We’re looking for a commercially driven Channel Account Manager to grow Binalyze’s VAR and reseller ecosystem, turning signed partners into active sellers and creating repeatable partner-led revenue. This is a hands-on commercial role, not a partner-programme administration role. You’ll build strong relationships with priority partners, create joint business plans, generate pipeline and help partners identify, progress and ultimately own Binalyze opportunities across their customer bases. What you’ll do Activate existing signed VAR and reseller partners and grow the partner ecosystem. Build commercial relationships with priority partners and their sales teams. Create and execute joint business plans with clear pipeline and revenue goals. Build mindshare so Binalyze is actively positioned by partner sellers. Identify, qualify and progress opportunities across partner customer bases. Work with Binalyze sellers on strategic joint opportunities where appropriate. Enable partners to identify, develop and close their own Binalyze opportunities over time. Recruit new partners selectively where there are clear capability, coverage or market gaps. Run regular partner pipeline and performance reviews. Measure success through active partners, partner-generated pipeline and partner-generated ARR. Coordinate with Binalyze technical teams to ensure partners receive effective technical enablement. Nice to have Cybersecurity, digital forensics, incident response, SOC, EDR or related security-technology experience. Experience with MSSPs or security-focused VARs and resellers. Experience helping to build or scale an indirect sales motion in a high-growth SaaS business. Familiarity with CRM and partner-management tools. title: Interim Performance Marketing Manager - 3 month contract
description: About Bike Club We're customer obsessed. We put the customer at the heart of everything we do - and we're looking for people who feel the same way. Bike Club is changing the way families access children's bikes. Through our subscription model, we make it easy for families to get the right bike at the right time, while keeping bikes in circulation for longer. We are a purpose-led, fast-growing business with a strong focus on customer growth, retention and building a more circular approach to children's cycling. The Role We need a commercially driven performance marketer for three months to manage and improve customer acquisition across the UK and Germany while we hire a permanent Performance Marketing Manager. You will manage our performance marketing agency and own delivery of our paid acquisition plan, using customer and commercial data to recommend where to invest, test and optimise. We are also open to a fractional role for the right candidate. What You'll Do Manage our performance marketing agency and other acquisition partners, challenging recommendations where needed. Oversee day-to-day performance and optimisation of paid acquisition across the UK and Germany. Lead the restructure of paid search around parent needs and intent (sizing, outgrown bikes, exchange) rather than subscription terms. Recommend how acquisition budget is allocated across markets, channels and campaigns. Own reporting on CAC, conversion, ROAS, payback and customer value, working with Finance and Data. Set up a simple test-and-learn roadmap across channels, audiences, propositions, creative and landing pages. Focus on acquiring high-quality, sustainable customers, not just volume. What success looks like at three months Acquisition delivered to plan in the UK and Germany. Clear acquisition KPIs and reporting in place. Paid search restructure under way, with an accountable relationship with the agency. A documented test roadmap and handover for the permanent hire. About You You'll be an experienced performance marketer who combines channel knowledge with strong commercial and analytical judgement. Experience in performance marketing or growth within a consumer business or agency. Experience managing agencies and a multi-channel market. Strong analytical and commercial judgement, able to turn data into clear actions. Able to land quickly and work well with Marketing, Data, Finance and Commercial colleagues. German market experience is a plus. Available immediately! Why BikeClub? You'll be joining a business with a clear purpose, a genuinely different proposition and significant opportunity to grow. This is an opportunity to have a meaningful impact on the next stage of Bike Club's growth, while helping build a more sustainable way for families to access children's bikes. title: Staff Software Engineer - Full Stack
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and partners every day.</p> <p>From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo’s growth at scale.</p> <p>In November 2023 we launched our non-food retail offering, Deliveroo ‘Shopping’, where we work with large and small merchants. We oversee all operations within the grocery and retail ecosystem, ensuring stores are equipped to receive and efficiently process orders. Our solutions empower stores to manage orders seamlessly through multiple channels, including our in-house app, API integration, and devices pre-installed with our software. Additionally, we provide tools to maintain and update product catalogs, ensuring accurate inventory for consumers. The technology we’ve developed enables our partners to pick the correct items swiftly while keeping inventory data current, optimizing both efficiency and accuracy.</p> <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Staff Software Engineer</strong> to join our <strong>London, UK - Hybrid (3 days from the office)</strong> team. In this role, you’ll help us define technical solutions for critical business problems and lead the technical direction for complex, high-scale systems.</p> <p>Get to know our<a href="https://careers.deliveroo.co.uk/software-engineering-at-deliveroo/"> Engineering</a> team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.</p> <h2><strong>What You’ll Be Doing</strong></h2> <p>You’ll be joining a high-impact engineering group focused on solving unstructured and ambiguous challenges. You will act as a technical authority, aligning non-adjacent teams to deliver results that move the needle for the entire organisation.</p> <p>Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:</p> <ul> <li style="line-height: 1;"><strong>Drive Technical Excellence:</strong> Act as a subject matter expert, providing high-level reviews and technical advice across multiple teams.<br><br></li> <li style="line-height: 1;"><strong>Architect Scalable Solutions:</strong> Define and design technical solutions for complex business problems within a high-traffic environment (20krpm+).<br><br></li> <li style="line-height: 1;"><strong>Lead Strategic Direction:</strong> Influence the long-term technical roadmap and manage project timelines, risks, and sustainable delivery paces.<br><br></li> <li style="line-height: 1;"><strong>Mentor & Coach:</strong> Support the growth of engineers across all levels and partner with up-and-coming leaders to scale our engineering culture.<br><br></li> <li style="line-height: 1;"><strong>Shape the Team:</strong> Lead engineering interviews and contribute to recruiting strategy to ensure we maintain a high bar for talent.<br><br></li> </ul> <h2><strong>What You’ll Need to Thrive</strong></h2> <p>Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:</p> <ul> <li style="line-height: 1;"><strong>Deep Technical Mastery:</strong> Significant experience building web-based applications at scale and a pride in writing readable, well-tested software.<br><br></li> <li style="line-height: 1;"><strong>Polyglot Mindset:</strong> Proficiency in (or a strong desire to learn) languages such as <strong>(Go, Ruby/Rails, Python, Scala, React or Rust)</strong><strong><br><br></strong></li> <li style="line-height: 1;"><strong>Distributed Systems Expertise:</strong> Practical experience with relational databases <strong>(PostgreSQL) and NoSQL backends (Redis, DynamoDB, or Elasticsearch).</strong><strong><br><br></strong></li> <li style="line-height: 1;"><strong>High-Scale Architecture:</strong> Proven ability to design and operate systems handling massive request volumes and complex logistical workflows.<br><br></li> <li style="line-height: 1;"><strong>Strategic Leadership:</strong> Strong understanding of how to align multiple disciplines and teams to resolve ambiguous technical challenges.<br><br></li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why Join Us?</strong></h2> <p>At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community organisers, proud parents, and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa </span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a <em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h2><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Technical Advisory practice are looking for an experienced Senior Consultant to join the team.</span> </span></h2> <p>Our Energy and Resources team works across the energy value chain and supports many of the world’s leading energy companies, infrastructure investors, private-equity funds, lenders, developers, network owners and government organisations. You will have the opportunity to work on transactions and projects across the UK, Europe and internationally. Our Market and Transactions unit is looking for an experienced Senior Consultant or Manager to join our Technical Advisory capability, working at the heart of the energy transition and supporting investors, developers, lenders, utilities and public-sector organisations on grid connection, grid compliance and electrical network decisions. Our Technical Advisory team combines engineering, transaction advisory and technical due diligence experience to help clients understand the connection, compliance, curtailment and network risks that determine the cost, programme and value of energy assets. You will work closely with Baringa’s market, commercial, market access and transaction advice teams, while bringing an independent and engineering-led perspective to investment and development decisions.</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What you will be doing</span></span></h3> <p>The core of the role is applying a high voltage power systems background to the grid and electrical workstreams of buy-side, sell-side and lender technical due diligence, and to connection and network advice, across generation, storage, interconnector, network and large demand assets. You will typically:</p> <ul> <li>Support infrastructure investors, lenders, developers, utilities and public-sector clients on grid connection, compliance and electrical network questions, bringing a power systems perspective to investment and development decisions.</li> <li>Review connection applications, offers, agreements and ICP or IDNO arrangements, and the delivery programme behind them, including reinforcement dependencies, outage requirements, network operator obligations and energisation milestones, and what delay would mean for commercial operation.</li> <li>Assess grid code and connection compliance requirements such as reactive power and voltage control, frequency response, fault ride-through and power quality, and how compliance will be demonstrated through to energisation.</li> <li>Review power system studies prepared by developers, contractors and third parties, including load flow, fault level, voltage step change and harmonics, and whether the assumptions and results are reasonable.</li> <li>Assess network constraints and curtailment assumptions, including export limitation and flexible or non-firm connection arrangements, and what they mean for output and revenue.</li> <li>Review transmission and distribution infrastructure, including substations, switchgear, transformers, cables, overhead lines, protection and control systems and electrical balance of plant, and comment on design, condition and capacity headroom.</li> <li>Benchmark electrical capital and operating costs, connection charges, reinforcement liabilities and replacement assumptions, and whether they are reflected in the business plan.</li> <li>Turn complex and often incomplete technical information into clear, practical findings and recommendations for engineering and investment audiences through reports, risk registers and presentations, and take part in client discussions, technical Q&A sessions, management meetings and site</li> </ul> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Your skills and experience</span></span></h3> <p><strong>Essential experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>You will typically have 5 to 8 years of relevant professional experience, although we welcome candidates outside this range with particularly relevant experience.</li> <li>You will have a strong foundation in electrical or power systems engineering, supported by a relevant degree, equivalent qualification or substantial practical experience.</li> <li>You will have demonstrable experience undertaking technical due diligence, Lender’s Technical Advisor assignments or comparable investor-facing technical assessments of power and grid infrastructure. This will include assessing capital and operating expenditure assumptions, identifying material technical and investment risks, and taking ownership of substantive deliverables such as technical report sections, risk registers or red flag presentations.</li> <li>You will have experience of grid connection processes, including connection strategies, applications, offers and agreements, alongside an understanding of grid code requirements and technical compliance processes for generation, storage or large demand projects.</li> <li>You will have hands-on experience independently undertaking power system studies, including relevant network modelling and analysis, using industry-standard software such as DIgSILENT PowerFactory, PSS®E, PSCAD or IPSA.</li> <li>You will have experience taking responsibility for technical workstreams, coordinating specialist inputs, engaging directly with clients and supporting junior colleagues, appropriate to your level of experience.</li> <li>Chartered Engineer status, or demonstrable progress towards chartership, would be desirable but is not essential.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience of network constraints and curtailment, including constraint drivers, export limitation, and flexible or non-firm connection arrangements, and their consequences for asset output.</li> <li>Experience of the GB connection and compliance regime, including engagement with the national system operator, transmission owners and network operators, and familiarity with the operational notification stage gate process, would be highly relevant.</li> <li>Experience of connection and compliance regimes in other European markets, or of interconnector, HVDC or offshore transmission projects, would be valuable.</li> <li>Experience of connection charging, reinforcement liabilities, securities, network charges, or the regulatory framework governing connections and network investment would be useful.</li> <li>Experience with network owners or operators, including asset condition assessment, capacity headroom, network performance and investment planning, would be relevant.</li> <li>Experience using operational or network datasets, automation or AI-enabled tools to support technical assessment and document review would be beneficial, provided outputs remain transparent, auditable and subject to professional judgement. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa </span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. Our focus now spans from brand and market positioning through to deeper client relationships, improved win rates, revenue growth, and increased net margin. This is being underpinned by an operational transformation including cNPS, new ways of working, and a content management platform driving greater efficiency and effectiveness.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We’re now looking for the marketing and business development professionals that can guide us through this exciting transformation.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p> </p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What you will be doing</span></span></h3> <ul> <li>Partnering with the Clients & Marketing Exec Sponsor and sector leadership teams to shape and deliver strategic marketing plans that advance sector priorities and drive measurable commercial impact. </li> <li>Leading the end‑to‑end delivery of campaign and event programmes, ensuring high‑quality execution and measurable commercial impact.  </li> <li>Building a strong understanding of client challenges, market trends, competitor activity, and Baringa’s sector capabilities to refine messaging, targeting, and segmentation.   </li> <li>Managing the in‑sector marketing team (where applicable), providing coaching, development, and day‑to‑day support.  </li> <li>Championing consistency, collaboration, and efficiency across sectors by working closely with fellow BPs and the wider Clients & Marketing team.   </li> <li>Leading the creation of compelling messaging and visuals that clearly differentiate Baringa in the market. Leveraging thought leadership, client success stories, and insight‑driven narratives to deliver standout campaigns and assets.   </li> <li>Owning the sector marketing budget, ensuring responsible management, cost control, and ongoing value‑for‑money improvements.   </li> <li>Bringing the sector strategy to life across the business—building alignment, energy, and advocacy for campaign activity. </li> </ul> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Your skills and experience</span> </span></h3> <ul> <li>Proven track record in shaping marketing strategy and the appropriate selection of tactics to drive a business forward and increase customer engagement and sales; use of the full multichannel mix.  Strategic marketing experience in a B2B environment.   </li> <li>Experience in professional services marketing, with a focus on Public Sector/Government clients.</li> <li>Expert relationship building and network creation – internally and with external parties.  Ability to work across all levels with impact, effectiveness and influence.   </li> <li>A background in Business Development, Account Growth and relationship management will be advantageous </li> <li>Proactive in pre-empting, identifying, resolving and escalating issues.  Self-sufficient, self-starter.   </li> <li>Ideally educated to Degree level or equivalent. Ideally CIM Diploma-qualified or equivalent.    </li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What a career at Baringa will give you</span> </span></h2> <h3><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);">Putting</span> </span><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(208, 0, 111);">People</span> </span><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">First.</span> </span></h3> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. title: People Advisor
description: About Swap Swap is the infrastructure behind modern agentic commerce. The only AI-native platform connecting backend operations with a forward-thinking storefront experience. Built for brands that want to sell anything - anywhere, Swap centralises global operations, powers intelligent workflows, and unlocks margin-protecting decisions with real-time data and capability. Our products span cross-border, tax, returns, demand planning, and our next-generation agentic storefront, giving merchants full transparency and the ability to act with confidence. At Swap, we’re building a culture that values clarity, creativity, and shared ownership as we redefine how global commerce works. About the role In the People Advisor role, you’ll work closely with the HRBP and wider People team to deliver a proactive, high-quality People service across Swap. You’ll act as a trusted advisor to managers and employees, providing practical guidance and support across employee relations, performance management, manager coaching and the wider employee lifecycle. Combining hands-on HR expertise with a solutions-focused approach, you’ll help managers navigate complex people matters confidently, ensure consistent and compliant People practices across our global teams, and drive continuous improvement through data, technology and automation as Swap continues to scale. Key Responsibilities Employee Relations Support and, where appropriate, lead employee relations matters, including disciplinary, grievance, capability, performance, absence management, flexible working and family leave. Use sound judgement and discretion, and escalate complex or high-risk cases to the HRBP. Own probation and absence management end to end, giving managers and employees practical, timely advice and escalating more complex matters. Manager Coaching & Capability Coach and support managers to handle people issues confidently and consistently, including performance management, calibration, capability development and challenging conversations. Partner with People Managers to provide 1:1 coaching, support and guidance on employee relations issues, in support of the HRBP. Employee Lifecycle & People Operations Act as the day-to-day point of contact for employees and managers on HR questions across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, policy interpretation, benefits and performance management, working alongside the People Operations team. Lead on family leave and flexible working requests. Maintain accurate employee records and HR systems, and help build out People processes and documentation. Help coordinate and run core HR cycles, including performance reviews, compensation planning and engagement surveys. Compliance Help ensure compliance with employment law and best practice across the UK, Europe and the US, in consultation with the HRBP and external counsel as needed. Continuous Improvement Work with the People Operations team to drive continuous improvement across the People function. Identify opportunities to simplify processes and improve workflows, and use AI and automation to create efficiency and free up time for more strategic partnering. Requirements CIPD Level 3 (or equivalent qualification or experience). 3–5 years’ HR generalist or advisory experience, ideally in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Confident and knowledgeable enough to manage employee relations issues independently, with sound judgement on when to escalate. A proactive, solutions-oriented approach and a track record of taking initiative. Exposure to multi-jurisdiction employment matters is an advantage, given Swap Commerce’s footprint across the UK, Ireland, the Netherlands, the US, Israel, Spain and Canada. Strong technical capability and data literacy, and comfort using data and technology to inform decisions and drive efficiency. What we offer 💰 Competitive base salary: Pay that reflects your experience and the impact you’ll have, reviewed regularly as you grow with us. 📈 Stock options: Own a piece of what we’re building. As a high-growth scale-up, you’ll share in the upside as the company grows. 🏖️ Generous PTO: Competitive annual leave, with public holidays on top, plus your birthday off so you can celebrate properly. 🏥 Private healthcare: Comprehensive private medical cover, so you can get the care you need quickly. 🏦 Pension contributions: Company contributions to help you build long-term financial security. 🧘 Wellness benefits: Support for your physical health and wellbeing, so you can look after yourself in the way that works for you. 💚 Mental health support: Access to mental health resources and support, because looking after your mind matters as much as your body. 👶 Enhanced maternity and paternity leave: Extra support when you’re growing your family, so you can focus on what matters most. 🏡 Flexible working: Choose how and where you do your best work, with the trust and autonomy to manage your own time. ✈️ Work abroad for 4 weeks a year: Take your laptop somewhere new for up to four weeks each year, whether that’s family, travel, or a change of scenery. 🎉 Quarterly team offsite budget: A dedicated budget each quarter for your team to get together, connect, and have fun. 🍻 Thursday happy hour: Wind down the week with your colleagues at our Thursday happy hour, held across all of our locations. 🥞 Breakfast Mondays: Start the week with a good meal and good company. Diversity & Equal Opportunities: We embrace diversity and equality in a serious way. We are committed to building a team with a variety of backgrounds, skills, and views. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. Creating a culture of equality isn't just the right thing to do; it's also the smart thing. description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. The team is highly iterative: it looks at the top issues we see on the road, root causes them, and drives them out through data, model and evaluation changes, working closely with other teams across
